slot.brief: Determine whether a given function is odd/even and whether it is strictly monotonic on a stated interval.

stem: For $f(x)=x^3-3x$, which statement about its symmetry and monotonicity on $[-1,1]$ is correct?
options: It is odd and strictly increasing.
It is even and strictly decreasing.
It is odd and strictly decreasing.
It is neither odd nor even, and is not monotonic.

verdicts.working: Since f(-x)=-f(x), f is odd. Its derivative f'(x)=3(x^2-1) is negative for -1<x<1, so f is strictly decreasing on [-1,1].

working:
